name: yahoo-fantasy-history-exporter
description: Chrome extension that exports a Yahoo Fantasy Football league's full history as JSON.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content/yahoo-detector.js && node --check sidepanel/sidepanel.js && node --check lib/yahoo-api.js && node --check lib/yahoo-normalizer.js && node --check lib/yahoo-session.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))"
